tasks.model:
Hi Tom,
Thanks for your email. Last summer I went to the seaside with my family. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach. Every day I swam in the sea and played volleyball with my cousins. In the evening we ate ice cream and walked along the pier. It was fantastic! Next year I want to go there again. Would you like to come with me? We can swim, play games and visit the old town. Write back soon.
Best wishes,
XYZ

Hello everyone!
Last weekend was great. On Saturday I met my friends in the park, and we played football for two hours. On Sunday I helped my dad in the garden, and then we cooked dinner together. My favourite moment was the football match because we won! I think a weekend outside is the best idea. You should try it. Go to a park, take a ball and invite your friends. It is simple, fun and free. See you next time!
XYZ

Our class is going to visit the science museum next Friday. We want to see an interesting exhibition about space and take a lot of photos. My hobby is drawing. I have been drawing since I was seven, because my grandmother gave me a box of pencils. I like it because I can relax after school and show my ideas on paper.
